_comment: Declarative registry of PDF/audio source collections for the German media pipeline. Add a source = add an entry here (no code change). Paths are relative to the german/ folder. Fields: slug, family (goethe|netzwerk|goyal — groups per-publisher combined sheets), publisher, exam, level, variant, title (display name), source_note (provenance line), pdf, audio, frozen (true = already delivered; exporters must never regenerate it).

exports._comment: Shape of this language's export tree, read by _engine/build_exports.py. Exists so German can run the shared exporter instead of a forked copy (gap P1).

omit_columns._comment: Columns this language can NEVER populate, declared rather than inferred from whatever happens to be empty today. Inferring would let the schema change shape silently every time a book is added -- option_d is empty because THESE ten books have no five-option items, not because German cannot have them. Declaring it means the schema moves when a human decides. chapter: German's schema has no chapter concept and never wrote the frontmatter field (absent on all 636 pages). translation/gender: the corpus is monolingual.
omit_columns._option_d_note: option_d/option_e are deliberately NOT omitted, though they are empty in all ten books. Omitting them splits the language against itself: the seven frozen books can never be regenerated, so their sheets would keep 16 columns while live books moved to 14, and verify_exports correctly refuses a header that varies within one language. Revisit only if the frozen books are ever unfrozen.

answer_key.checked: 2026-08-11: p002 (imprint page) states 'Lösungen, Transkripte u.v.m. zum Download unter www.klett-sprachen.de/netzwerk-neu' — the key is a publisher download, not printed in this book. No Lösungen section in the book itself. 328 of 852 answerable items blank (38.5%), consistent with a separate key.
answer_key.note: 38.5% blank correct_answer is CORRECT, not a gap: a Kursbuch does not print its own answers. Includes 23 true-false items (e.g. the p057 and p069 listening comprehensions) whose answers exist only in the download.

caveats: Items on p030 are a 'Kreuzen Sie an' tick-box listening task (which places does the taxi driver name?) with no printed answer words. Each option is stored as a true-false item answered ja/nein, whereas the rest of the corpus uses Richtig/Falsch. Neither form is verbatim — the book prints a checkbox — so this is a representation inconsistency, recorded rather than silently rewritten. Waived in accepted_answer_flags.

Answer-value casing is inconsistent within this book: 4 'richtig' and 5 'falsch' are lowercase where the corpus standard is capitalised. verify_answers.py would normalise these; the pass has not been run because it mutates a delivered book and requires a re-export plus a Drive re-upload.

answer_key.note: No printed key, so the 90.6% of items carrying an answer were determined from the exercise itself (e.g. 'der/das/die? ___ Bahnhof' has one grammatical answer). That is derivation from the printed material, not invention, but it is why the blank rate is far lower than the Kursbuch's despite both being separate-guide.
